Place towers on a small grid, defend your base from incoming enemy waves, and earn resources over time to strengthen your defenses. Every decision matters, as limited space forces you to think carefully about positioning and upgrades. With clean visuals, smooth gameplay, and gradually increasing difficulty, Idle Defense Grid offers a relaxed yet strategic experience. Easy to understand but challenging to master, the game rewards smart planning and long-term thinking.

Place towers on the grid to stop incoming enemies Towers attack automatically while you earn resources over time Upgrade your defenses survive increasingly difficult waves and protect your base as long as possible

title: rooftop runner
description:
Game Objective The goal in Rooftop Runner is simple: run as far as you can without falling. As you move across rooftops, you must: Jump over gaps between buildings Avoid obstacles and hazards Collect coins scattered across rooftops Stay ahead of danger and survive as long as possible The longer you run, the higher your score becomes. How to Play Playing Rooftop Runner is easy to learn but challenging to master. Basic Controls Move Forward Automatically – Your character runs automatically. Jump – Tap or press the jump key to leap across rooftop gaps. Change Direction / Dodge – Move left or right to avoid obstacles. Collect Coins – Run through coins to increase your score and rewards. Timing your jumps correctly is important. If you jump too early or too late, you may fall between buildings. Collect Coins and Power-Ups Coins appear across rooftops and help you increase your score. In some versions of the game, coins can also be used to: Unlock new characters Buy

title: Stellar Pulse
description:
Stellar Pulse is a fast-paced arcade game set in deep space. Pilot a small bioluminescent fish through glowing neon gates: cyan barriers above and magenta ones below, with only a narrow gap between them. Gravity pulls you down while each tap or key press gives you a short thrust upward. The gap slowly shrinks and gravity ramps up as your score rises, so timing and precision matter. Dodge every ring, beat your high score, and try not to clip the edges—one touch of the barriers or the floor and your flight is over.

How to play:
Input Action Tap click Thrust same as flapping mdash impulse upward Space Thrust uarr Up arrow Thrust PLAY AGAIN after game over Restart

title: Roof Rush 3D
description:
Roof Rush 3D is a high-octane urban runner where you navigate a pole-vaulting master across a dangerous city skyline. Collect pieces to grow your pole and use it to slide across parallel rails, but stay centered—lose your balance, and you fall! Dodge saws and obstacles that shrink your pole while progressing through vibrant, color-shifting levels. Unlock cool skins like the Ninja or Zombie, dominate the Endless mode, and reach the finish line for a cinematic victory celebration.

How to play:
Move Click and drag or slide Left and Right Run Automatic Rail Sliding Keep the player centered between rails Growth Pick up cylinders to extend your pole Survival Avoid red blocks and saws to prevent the pole from breaking

title: Color Pixel Flow
description:
Send pigs onto the conveyor to rain balls onto matching pixel cubes. Each pig has a number above its head—this is its ammo and determines how many hits it delivers. Once a pig runs out, it leaves the stage. If it still has ammo left, it moves into one of five waiting slots and can be sent back onto the conveyor for another round. The conveyor has limited capacity, so timing matters—send too many pigs at once and you’ll have to wait. Choose the right order, manage the flow, and break down the cubes step by step. A simple, satisfying loop: tap → launch → clear → repeat.

How to play:
Tap a pig to deploy it onto the conveyor Tap pigs in waiting slots to redeploy them Pigs automatically target matching color cubes Manage timing to avoid exceeding conveyor capacity

title: UNRAVEL
description:
UNRAVEL is a minimalist sliding puzzle with a deceptively simple rule: every block on the board has an arrow pointing in one direction.
